hints.title: Simulation Step Condition
hints.text: At second i, allocate i capacity units to the stick with greater remaining units (breaking ties toward stick 1).

hints.title: Crash Condition
hints.text: The program crashes at second i if both memory sticks have strictly fewer than i available units.

hints.title: Step Progression
hints.text: Iterate i from 1 upwards, deducting i from the chosen stick until a crash occurs.

hints.title: Full Implementation

variables: M is max of initial memory1 and memory2
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Memory values up to 2^31 require at most ~2*10^5 steps since total allocated memory grows quadratically as i*(i+1)/2.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Direct simulation executes in O(sqrt(M)) operations and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate realizes that total time is bounded by sqrt(2 * 2^31) ~ 65536 steps.
